expected_outcomes: Applicable work has current, proportionate verification evidence.
required_actions: Define verification before implementation and report exact results.
acceptance: Applicable checks pass or failures are reported exactly.
verification: Run the selected test, check, build, or review command.
evidence: Command, exit code, output, and any manual-review record.
failure_conditions: Completion is claimed without applicable evidence.
exceptions: Record an approved exception with scope, owner, review date, and expiry.
